# Wowhead attribution

NPC names and numeric display references in this directory are attributed to
[Wowhead](https://www.wowhead.com/classic). Individual source page URLs and
retrieval provenance are retained in `npc-models.json`.

Wowhead and its source materials retain their respective rights and terms.
World of Warcraft names and references concern Blizzard Entertainment's game.
This projection does not assert an open content license over those materials
or provide legal clearance. It contains no game art, complete source pages,
or tooltip markup.

Pull Fiction is not affiliated with Wowhead or Blizzard Entertainment.
